title: Turkish Past Counterfactual Conditional (-seydi)
summary: Expressing unreal or impossible past conditional scenarios.
explanation: Attach '-seydi/-saydı' to verb stems to express past counterfactuals or regrets (e.g., gelseydi = if he/she had come).

example_translations.ex_trsed_1: If he/she had come yesterday, he/she would have seen the book.

common_error_explanations.err_trsed_1: Use '-seydi' for unreal past conditional scenarios.
